entities.name: Brannon
entities.description: A young pyromancer acolyte in Keral Keep on Regatha who admires Chandra.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: Keep on Regatha where Brannon lives.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: Planeswalker pyromancer who stole the Dragon Scroll.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker mindmage sent to retrieve the Dragon Scroll.

entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: Scroll Chandra took and Jace sought.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: Plane where the prelate sent Jace.

events.summary: Jace, sent by the prelate to retrieve the Dragon Scroll, first encountered Brannon and read his mind, then followed him to Keral Keep.
events.quote: Jace learned of Chandra by reading Brannon's mind

events.summary: Brannon presented Chandra with a metal necklace he had made.
events.quote: presented her with a metal necklace, which he had made for her himself

events.summary: Jace walked in and demanded the scroll, sparking a duel with Chandra.
events.quote: This quickly escalated into a full-on duel between Jace and Chandra.

events.summary: Jace used an illusion of Brannon as a hostage, then posed as Brannon himself to grab the scroll and planeswalk away.
events.quote: Jace used the opportunity to grab the scroll from Chandra, stunning her and then planeswalking away.

events.summary: Chandra admitted defeat but had secretly copied the scroll's symbols.
events.quote: she had secretly copied the symbols of the scroll earlier

relations.quote: This quickly escalated into a full-on duel between Jace and Chandra.
